address: 1120 Wiset Road, Rawai, Mueang Phuket, Phuket, 83100, Thailand
bio: Located near Rawai Beach, Mook Manee stands out for its array of live seafood for diners to choose from, including squid, tiger prawns, a variety of crabs, and 3kg Phuket rainbow lobster. The restaurant holds up to 300, but the best seats offer views of the vibrant seafood market trading outside. Menu highlights include the fragrant stir-fried clams with chilli paste. A wooden terrace on the beach is also available....
